citations.context: And he is able to serve you in that way because in him is no lack. But if God doesn't need that, if he's not needy, why would he demand it? Why would he punish those who don't worship him? Why, in the same commandment are we told that God is a jealous God? God being jealous shows that he is a needy God. And then God goes on in verse 5 to say, For I, the Lord your God am a jealous God.

citations.context: There is nothing which produces more wrath, more anger, than when I see another man try and flirt with my wife. That makes me so angry. But did you know this, brothers and sisters in Christ? You are married to God. And the Bible says the Lord thy God is a jealous God. So whenever you go off cheating on him, it produces anger, it produces jealousy in him. Because you belong to him. And you better be obedient to him.
